0022600031.text: The Timberwolves (6-3, third in the Northwest and 7th in the West) visit the Pelicans (4-4, fifth in the Southwest and 11th in the West) in an NBA Cup West Group B game, Minnesota's 10th of the season, with Minnesota on a two-game win streak and New Orleans on four straight wins. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery; averaging 33.3 points and 33.7 minutes this season), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while New Orleans is missing Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 132-126 win in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
